Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

multidesign 0.1.0.9000 (Development)

  • Added design_spec() and the mv() formula special for frame-native design definitions.
  • Added compile_design() with observation- and entity-block expansion, component-aware term metadata, factor-preserving dense parity, and random grouping metadata. Imaging assays remain owned by fmridataset.

Developed by Bradley R. Buchsbaum.
